changelog: Initial public release of the documented Klik agent-memory and scheduled-task import workflow.
summary: Import your agent's memory files and scheduled tasks into Klik. Discovers memory files and scheduled tasks from the current agent's storage, lets you review and clean them, then uploads securely to Klik. Requires a 6-digit import code from Klik App > Settings > "Import from Agent". Triggers: "import to klik", "migrate memory to klik", "upload my memory to klik", "send my scheduled tasks to klik", "klik import".
